decision: Strip spaces/tabs, parse the four timestamps, use short column names.
evidence: TAB on 100% of order/payment times and on 18,370 location labels; all timestamps parse.

decision: is_Abnormal = 1 when end_cause is one of the 13 fault/failure causes; 'Charging ends normally' and 'User stops charging' are normal.
evidence: Our counts reproduce the dataset's own previous-abnormal columns in ~100% of rows (alternative B does not). Share 18.58% (53.93% if user stops were abnormal).

decision: Keep the 9,058 zero-energy sessions labelled normal.
evidence: Plausible user cancellations; filtering on energy (post-session) cannot be repeated at prediction time.

decision: No deletion, no mean/median or model imputation. Trees: keep NaN + flags. Linear models: fill with the training maximum + keep the flags.
evidence: NaN equals the no-history flag in 100% of rows (structural); missingness is related to the outcome.

decision: Do not use sessions before 2020-04-01 for modelling.
evidence: History columns incomplete at file start (new users 31% vs ~13%); different failure mix in Q1-2020.
Volume, abnormal share (13.7%-26.3%) and failure mix change over time.

decision: Exclude energy, the four money columns, end_time, payment_time and end_cause from the predictors.
evidence: Only known after the session; univariate AUC 0.82-0.85, higher than any start-time variable.
Stamped after the start in 57.2% of training sessions; weak, irregular signal (AUC 0.59).

decision: Keep all observations. Trees: no change. Linear models: log1p on skewed columns + standardisation.
evidence: Extremes are valid: idle posts (~2x abnormal), fleet accounts, real storm days; Isolation Forest agrees.
Changes over time (Section 7); 28 training sessions ended after the cut-off and were purged.

decision: Add hour, dow (circular) and rain_flag; no month/year/time index.
evidence: Calendar is the only start-time information in the timestamp; rain is zero-inflated.

decision: Drop electricity_price, 6 abnormal counts, 2 post no-history flags, user_no_previous_completed_session; user_id not a feature.
evidence: Exact functions / no variability / ~identical indicator / key field (Section 12.2).

decision: Trees and regularised linear models: all 29 features. Plain linear/distance models: reduced set (|ρ| < 0.90).
evidence: VIF > 10 only for long user windows; max VIF falls below 10 in the reduced set.
PCA needs about half the components for 90% variance; top component has AUC ~0.51. Bins lose the ordering.

decision: Fit encoders, NaN fill and scaler on TRAIN only, inside a Pipeline.
evidence: Fitting on all periods changes the learned values (table above).

decision: No resampling of the prepared data; any resampling/weights only inside training folds (Task 2).
evidence: Imbalance ~1:4.4 and it changes between periods (17.8% / 21.1% / 17.6%).
